Quick Answer

It Reaches has 20 Steam Achievements. Most story and combat achievements unlock naturally, but five collectibles and the Fully Upgraded achievement are likely missable. Four achievements have hidden descriptions on Steam and require further in-game testing to confirm exact unlock conditions.

Overview

The list below is based on the official Steam Community global achievements page for It Reaches. Official names, descriptions, and global unlock percentages are confirmed. Unlock conditions for visible achievements are inferred from their descriptions; hidden achievements are marked as unknown until verified through direct playthrough.

Completion Tips

  • Save often: Use multiple save slots before major chapter transitions and before points of no return.
  • Explore thoroughly: The five collectible achievements require finding family items hidden in the environment.
  • Upgrade wisely: Resources for Fully Upgraded may be limited; prioritize one weapon if you want this achievement.
  • Test deaths and interactions: Some achievements require dying to specific enemies or interacting with specific objects.
  • Watch for hidden achievements: Four achievements hide their descriptions. We will update this page once their exact conditions are confirmed.

Hidden achievement conditions pending verification

The official Steam Community page hides descriptions for What is he made of?!, Forgiveness, Rest in Pieces, and Early Grave. We are playing through It Reaches to confirm their exact unlock conditions and will update this page as soon as they are verified.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many achievements are in It Reaches?

It Reaches has 20 Steam Achievements. This page lists every one with official descriptions, unlock conditions, and missable warnings.

Can I get all achievements in one playthrough?

Probably not. Several achievements are tied to collectibles, and fully upgrading a weapon may require resources spread across the game. Hidden achievements and Early Grave (5.8% unlock rate) suggest there may be ending-specific or challenge-based requirements.

Which achievements are missable?

The five collectible achievements (Toy Police Car, dog photograph, Toy Carousel, son's drawing, Worn Football) and Fully Upgraded are likely missable. Save before major chapter transitions if you are hunting collectibles.

What are the hidden achievements?

Steam hides the descriptions for What is he made of?!, Forgiveness, Rest in Pieces, and Early Grave. We are testing these in-game and will update exact unlock conditions once verified.

What is the rarest achievement?

Fully Upgraded is the rarest visible achievement at 3.7% global unlock rate. Early Grave is also rare at 5.8% but is hidden.
